description: PaymentRequirements whose extra.transactionVersions is [0, 1] (copied from the facilitator's /supported): the SDK's requirements type parses it and re-encodes it unchanged, as integers. An SDK that drops the field tells its clients the sponsor accepts version 0 only.

spec.quote: The facilitator advertises the versions it accepts as extra.transactionVersions in /supported, and the server MUST copy that value into PaymentRequirements.extra.transactionVersions.

description: extra.transactionVersions [1]: round-trips as written.

description: The offer advertises [0, 1] and the client and its signer support both: the client builds the highest version in the intersection, a version-1 message in the §3.1 version-1 layout (TransferChecked, Memo; budget in the header), and echoes extra.transactionVersions in accepted. The build judge verifies the header with a Rust sponsor accepting the offer's versions and compares the message version and header config with the kit's build.

spec.quote: The client MUST intersect the advertised versions ([0] when the field is absent) with the versions it and its signer support, then build the highest version in that intersection.

description: extra.transactionVersions absent: the advertised set is [0], so the client builds version 0 with the ComputeBudget prefix. A client that builds version 1 here sends a version the sponsor never accepted. The build judge verifies the header with a Rust sponsor accepting the offer's versions and compares the message version and header config with the kit's build.

spec.quote: It MUST fail with unsupported_transaction_version when the intersection is empty.

description: extra.transactionVersions [] (present, empty): only an absent field means [0]. The intersection is empty, so the client MUST fail with unsupported_transaction_version (RULINGS T2). spec.quote: It MUST fail with unsupported_transaction_version when the intersection is empty.

description: Version-1 static layout whose Memo nonce is 1300 hex characters: about 1.6 KB serialized, over version 0's 1232 bytes but within version 1's 4096. Accepted. Mutation: memo #0 replaced with 1300 hex characters.

spec.quote: A legacy or version-0 transaction MUST NOT exceed 1232 serialized bytes; a version-1 transaction MUST NOT exceed 4096 serialized bytes.

description: The same 1300-character Memo in a version-0 static layout: over 1232 bytes, rejected whatever else the sponsor accepts. Pair: x402-verify-v1-over-1232-accept. Mutation: memo #0 replaced with 1300 hex characters.

description: Version-1 static layout preceded by a SetComputeUnitLimit instruction: the runtime ignores it under version 1, so a sponsor bounding it bounds nothing. Pair: x402-verify-v1-accept. Mutation: ComputeBudget instruction with data [2, 64, 13, 3, 0] added.

spec.quote: A version-1 transaction that contains a Compute Budget instruction MUST be rejected.

description: Version-1 header without computeUnitLimit (budgeted zero compute units; it cannot execute after the sponsor pays the fee). Pair: x402-verify-v1-accept. Mutation: version-1 header computeUnitLimit removed.

spec.quote: In a version-1 transaction the same caps apply to the message TransactionConfig instead: computeUnitLimit MUST be present and MUST NOT exceed the configured maximum, loadedAccountsDataSizeLimit MUST be present, and priorityFee (total lamports) MUST satisfy priorityFee 1000000 <= maxPriorityFeeMicroLamports computeUnitLimit.

description: Version-1 header without loadedAccountsDataSizeLimit (budgeted zero bytes; it fails at load time after the sponsor pays the fee). Pair: x402-verify-v1-accept. Mutation: version-1 header loadedAccountsDataSizeLimit removed.

description: Version-1 header computeUnitLimit at the configured maximum (200000): accepted (the base layout already sits at the cap; this pins it explicitly next to its over-cap pair). Mutation: version-1 header computeUnitLimit set to 200000.

description: Version-1 header computeUnitLimit 200001, one unit over the configured maximum. Mutation: version-1 header computeUnitLimit set to 200001.

description: Version-1 priorityFee 1500 lamports over 300 units: exactly 5 lamports (5000000 micro-lamports) per unit, the fast-path cap, and under the 2000 lamport cap a sponsor may put on the total fee (scheme_exact_svm.md §2.2.1). Accepted (the cap is inclusive). Mutation: version-1 header computeUnitLimit set to 300 and priorityFee to 1500 lamports.

spec.quote: The legacy/version-0 Compute Budget price and the version-1 total priority fee MUST each be no greater than 5 lamports/CU on this path, using the normalization in §1.5 for version 1.

description: Version-1 priorityFee 1501 lamports over 300 units: one lamport above priorityFee * 1000000 <= 5000000 * 300, and still under a 2000 lamport cap on the total fee, so only the per-unit rule rejects it. A sponsor that compares the lamport total with the per-unit cap accepts it. Mutation: version-1 header computeUnitLimit set to 300 and priorityFee to 1501 lamports.

spec.quote: The legacy/version-0 Compute Budget price and the version-1 total priority fee MUST each be no greater than 5 lamports/CU on this path, using the normalization in §1.5 for version 1.
